item.title: F-Log #0001: PepsiCo: 3Q2026 results
item.description: PepsiCo (PEP) net revenue was 25.274 billion USD (+5.6% y/y) and +3.1% organically. y/y growth in PepsiCo (PEP) segments was: PFNA 0%, PBNA +5%, IB Franchise +8%, EMEA +8%, LatAm Foods +14%, and Asia Pacific Foods +10%. PepsiCo (PEP) gross margin was 54.4%, PepsiCo (PEP) operating income was 4.260 billion USD (+19%) with a 16.9% margin, and PepsiCo (PEP) core profit was 4.277 billion USD (+3%) with a core margin of 16.9% (−35 bps). PepsiCo (PEP) EPS was 2.23 USD (+17%), PepsiCo (PEP) core EPS was 2.34 USD (+2%), and PepsiCo (PEP) core in constant currency was +1.5%.

item.title: F-Log #0000: Definition of F-Logs
item.description:
F-Log is my journal of facts regarding companies from the Nasdaq-100 index. Each quarterly report of a specific company receives a separate entry, while insider transactions and other significant filings go into a collective log.

Data comes exclusively from official company documents, such as filings with the US SEC and investor relations materials. This information is collected and verified by my module operating on a separate server, which aggregates data from official sources.
